title: The manual gave CS_SANDBOX_ENGINE a default it does not have, and missed two variables
foundBy: session agent, walking README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader

evidence.verified: `grep -rhoE '"CS_SANDBOX_[A-Z_]+"' internal/ cmd/` lists 25 names. Every one a user can set is now in MANUAL.md's Environment section; the two left out are CS_SANDBOX_COVERAGE_LOG and CS_SANDBOX_IT_HOSTROUTE, which are test instrumentation, and CS_SANDBOX_SSH_BIND, which SBX-005 holds open on purpose.

details:
MANUAL.md's Environment section listed `CS_SANDBOX_ENGINE` with a default of `podman`. `internal/cli/create.go` reads it as `envOr("CS_SANDBOX_ENGINE", "")`, and the flag's own help says "default: firecracker on Linux/KVM, else podman". A reader on a Linux host with KVM would expect Podman and get Firecracker.

Two more variables the code reads were absent from the same tables: `CS_SANDBOX_GROUP`, which is `create`'s default group, and `CS_SANDBOX_TZ`, which sets the timezone a sandbox boots with and defaults to America/Los_Angeles.

`-f` also has a long form, `--force`, which appeared only in `--help`.
